title: Surface data-layer and UI failures to the person instead of swallowing them
description:
`bootstrap()` in `web/src/data/client.ts:32-53` catches any failure to load `/amplify_outputs.json`, logs to the console and defaults to cloud mode, so a broken deploy shows empty lists and odd sign-in behaviour with no message. There is no retry or backoff in `web/src/data/*`; the only timeout is `watchAuth`'s 12 s (`auth.ts:282`). About 20 empty `catch {}` blocks in the UI hide real failures: ratings (`score.ts:276`, `library.ts:156`), peaks (`flow/view.ts:91`, so a waveform never appears), tallies (`ranked-list.ts:131`), `hero-audio.ts:61,71`, `beat/view.ts:335`, `breakdown.ts:229`. Where errors do surface it is ad hoc `statusEl.textContent`. `keepCandidate` in `domain.ts` writes the Verdict, then the Clip, then CrateItems and returns on the first error, leaving partial state.

Done when: one shared error surface (a status bar or toast) exists and every non-localStorage catch reports through it; bootstrap failure is visible; the multi-step domain writes either roll back or are documented as idempotent and retried.

comments.author: home
comments.text: keepCandidate's multi-step writes (Verdict, Clip, CrateItems) are not called by the app today; left for when curation comes back.
